The board carries one accent, by default a heavy pink outline on the node, message or task the first glance names. A user flow or a process marks it with a `style` line and the check refuses a model that has none. The other five types may name it with a `%% focus:` line. | Kind | Shape | Colour | Key | Read from |
|---|---|---|---|---|

| Data store | Cylinder | Light violet | Data store | A cylinder |
| Sub-process | Predefined process | White | Sub-process | A subroutine |
| Input or output | Parallelogram | Light teal | Input or output | A parallelogram |
